more.title: Reliance Industries expands fuel exports to Africa, Europe as West Asia conflict disrupts supplies
more.description: Reliance Industries has redirected fuel exports to Africa, the Mediterranean and other European markets to capitalise on supply disruptions caused by the West Asia conflict, lifting its market share in these regions by about 50%. The strategy helped drive record quarterly earnings for its oil-to-chemicals business as global refining margins surged.

more.title: The Agoa trap: How Western tariffs are forcing South Africa back into a colonial economic corner
more.description: As Washington wraps up its annual review of the African Growth and Opportunity Act (Agoa), our economic commentators are panicking about the wrong numbers. They are staring at short-term export data, celebrating temporary windfalls from high global commodity prices and completely missing the devastating long-term wedge being driven straight into the heart of South Africa’s industrial future.

more.title: Jemimah Rodrigues recovers from hamstring injury, eyes potential return during South Africa tour
more.description: Jemimah Rodrigues confirmed her recovery from a hamstring injury that left her sidelined for three months. She sustained the injury while playing for Southern Brave in August and missed significant tournaments. Following rehabilitation, Rodrigues announced on Instagram that her hamstring is now fit for action. She aims for a return during India's multi-format tour of South Africa in December.
